question.prompt: A streetlight \(P\) is 6 m above the ground. A person 1.5 m tall stands 6 m from the base of the lamppost. Find the length of the person's shadow. (Unit: m)

solutions.explanation: Let the shadow length be \(x\). By similar triangles, \(1.5/6=x/(x+6)\), so \(x+6=4x\), giving \(x=2\).
solutions.title: Similar triangles
